div.div: A space request asks for a kind of space, such as a height-adjustable desk, never a specific one. Requests the run cannot place join the single waitlist in the order they were made. If the person needs parking, a locker or a bike rack to come in at all, the request is placed only once that is secured too.

div.div: Publishing a placement creates an allocated BookingOccurrence, tied to its companions by a BookingLink. A placed request is frozen unless the person cancels. Required companion: a Hold is taken when the request is made, or the companion joins the waitlist if none is free.

text.tspan: Publishing a placement creates an allocated BookingOccurrence, tied to its companions by a BookingLink. A placed request is frozen unless the person cancels. Required companion: a Hold is taken when the request is made,
or the companion joins the waitlist if none is free.
